text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwe's low income housing programme will receive a further boost of Z$200 million this financial year -- equivalent to about 5,000 housing units -- from the U.S. Agency for International Development.
- Two prisoners serving long jail terms at Zimbabwe's Chikurubi Maximum Security Prison almost suceeded in escaping from the complex in a daring attempt at the weekend.

- The ongoing countrywide strike action by some Zimbabwean workers, including private security guards, has seen a slight increase in the crime rate, but police were quick to mobilise their resources and bring the situation under control.
